create_LReLUNet: create a Haiku transformed LReLUNet101 model for ImageNet classification with configurable depth and number of classes
build_ScaledUniformOrthogonal: build a ScaledUniformOrthogonal weight initializer for convolutional and fully-connected layers in JAX neural networks
test_lrelunet_loss: test the lrelunet_loss function that computes cross-entropy loss with L2 regularization and label smoothing for the LReLUNet model
run_LReLUNetImageNetExperiment: run the LReLUNetImageNetExperiment class to train the LReLUNet model on ImageNet using Jaxline
review_BlockV2: review the BlockV2 ResNet V2 block module that applies convolutional layers with activation without batch normalization or residual connections
